phase: independently accepted r2; current shelf and remote delivery pending

findings.title: Complete means contradictory things
findings.evidence: scripts/research_campaign.py:validate checks phase only; baseline status-complete-only
findings.impact: An empty framing campaign with status complete validates. UI shows complete without either research gate.
findings.repair: Require phase/status consistency and the same completion checks for any complete declaration; preserve valid sparse active and bounded partial work.
findings.actual_change: Status and phase must agree; either complete declaration invokes real required-artifact, recomputed integrity and current declared-review gates. Sparse active and zero-source bounded results have positive controls.

findings.title: Semantic review is prose theater at the completion boundary
findings.impact: Word counts and one citation permit contradicted claims and absent semantic review. Repeating generic words fills every gate.
findings.repair: Replace word-count proof with typed declared review of report and claim treatment, bound to current question, scope, report, source notes/ledgers and consequential context. Preserve legacy judgments as historical, never silently stamp them current. Recompute deterministic integrity rather than trusting a self-written pass file.
findings.actual_change: Removed word quotas as approval. Exact native subject covers inquiry, meaningful campaign fields, all evidence prose/ledgers, drafts and report; typed per-claim treatments and rationale are required. Missing, stale, needs-work or unresolved passing review cannot complete. Read-only digest never issues a verdict.

findings.title: A changed evidence note retains a fresh-looking verdict
findings.evidence: citation_audit.py inputs_sha256; changed-note fixture; app.js tone/disposition
findings.impact: Notes and scope can materially change while audit hashes remain current; the atlas paints supported green from unbound native text.
findings.repair: Bind evidence notes and scope to review subject. Display recorded historical judgments separately from current review; editing relevant content visibly invalidates current review until saved/reviewed. Read-only subject calculation must never generate approval.
findings.actual_change: Current review controls visible treatment. Changed notes/scope/unmarked prose invalidate review. Current qualified treatment stays neutral despite historical supported ledger text; absent review cannot paint green. Unsaved edits invalidate immediately.

findings.title: The report is not self-contained or necessarily visible
findings.evidence: citation_audit.py marker scan; missing-bibliography and hidden-citations fixtures
findings.impact: Markers can occur only in hidden comments; absent title/locator bibliography passes. Reader needs the app to discover sources.
findings.repair: Check visible prose outside comments/fences; require source entries with title and locator for cited records. Keep claims/numbers/causal entailment with substantive reviewer. Include readable bibliography and mechanism-matched synthesis examples.
findings.actual_change: Body citations need eligible sources and visible bibliography titles/locators; closed and unfinished comments and code fences cannot satisfy the visible prose check. Literal comment-in-fence control retains a legitimate bibliography. Projection is deliberately bounded, not arbitrary HTML conformance.

findings.title: Typed and temporal contracts are mostly unenforced
findings.impact: Numbers/objects count as inquiry and resume text, required fields disappear, duplicate JSON keys overwrite silently, no clock/cutoff validation exists.
findings.repair: Validate substantive field types, duplicate keys, IDs, joins and recorded dates with controlled errors. Accept sparse work and explicit unknown dates; reject impossible dates/offsets and post-cutoff publication when declared as a knowledge cutoff, without conflating later retrieval with later knowledge.
findings.actual_change: Substantive types, unique IDs, joins, duplicate JSON keys, exact counters and bounded timezone components are checked. Publication beyond declared cutoff fails; later retrieval is allowed. Review cannot predate recorded source access. Unknown source dates remain explicit.

findings.title: Source states require erasing the work that justified exclusion
findings.impact: A researcher cannot honestly retain opened/deeply-read history after excluding a source. Opened also ambiguously means successful reading or failed attempt.
findings.repair: Preserve acquired reading history when excluding/duplicating; require exclusion reason and canonical duplicate link. Inaccessible cannot substantiate a citation. Clarify opened successful content versus attempted access; actual source-state counts remain overlapping recorded events.
findings.actual_change: Exclusion after actual reading retains acquired history and a reason; duplicate needs a canonical record; excluded/inaccessible records cannot earn a citation. Real legacy NOAA FAQ is retained as excluded after reading rather than deleted or counted as corroboration.

findings.title: Assembly can replace a better report with stale drafts
findings.impact: A direct edit in Synthesis/native report is overwritten by draft concatenation without a comparison, backup, or refusal. Old structural/semantic receipts remain next to changed report.
findings.repair: Refuse changed existing reports unless explicit replace flag; retain prior report before replacement, write atomically, expose changed/current review state and lexical section order.
findings.actual_change: Differing existing report is preserved unless --replace is explicit. Authorized replacement retains exact prior bytes and writes atomically; changed report stales review. Lexical draft order and recovery are documented.

findings.title: Custody checks miss aliases, reparse roots and portable names
findings.evidence: workspace/campaign.py import resolves before checking links, checked_name permits CON.md; builder walks links
findings.impact: Import can conceal a linked source root; reserved names fail late; builder may ingest junction bytes or silently omit symlink files.
findings.repair: Reject unresolved symlinks/reparse ancestors before resolving aliases; preflight complete portable namespaces, strict native file boundary and controlled malformed request bodies. Stage import/create/build and preserve prior outputs on failure.
findings.actual_change: Reject unresolved link/reparse ancestors before alias resolution; preflight portable names, aliases and file/directory collisions. Stage create/import/build, constrain native file boundary, reject malformed request types. Actual Windows junction test passed.

findings.title: Save recovery is incomplete across multi-file failure
findings.impact: History is useful but a write failure leaves half-updated canonical records. Concurrent external agent writes are only detected before the loop.
findings.repair: Rollback ordinary write failures to original exact native bytes, report rollback failure distinctly, preserve recovery snapshot. Document that an actively writing external agent requires coordination; do not promise distributed atomicity.
findings.actual_change: Stage/validate before writes and recheck revision; preserve exact native history. Ordinary injected mid-save OSError restores original bytes. Incomplete rollback has a distinct recovery error. An actively writing external agent still requires coordination; no distributed atomicity claim.

findings.title: Campaigns disappear instead of asking for repair
findings.evidence: workspace/campaign.py:/api/list catches and ignores malformed campaign
findings.impact: A malformed campaign becomes invisible to its owner; no path or repair action appears.
findings.repair: List damaged native campaigns with bounded error and path, preserve open/native-file repair where possible, never convert parse failure into an empty library.
findings.actual_change: Malformed JSON and invalid typed navigation metadata remain visible as damaged. Native-file repair opens the exact corrupted bytes with an honest damaged title instead of borrowing the prior investigation context.

findings.title: Navigation and review presentation lose context
findings.evidence: app.js reading related-claim jump does not clear atlas filter; source filter leaves unrelated note selected; reportFile persists across campaign switch
findings.impact: A clicked claim may be replaced by another due to active filters; an empty reading search still displays an unrelated source; stale selected document opens blank in another campaign.
findings.repair: Reset incompatible filters on explicit jumps, align reader selection with visible queue, reset document to report on campaign switch, preserve comparison deliberately, and test actual browser task paths.
findings.actual_change: Explicit related-claim jumps clear incompatible filters; empty reading filters clear prior note; compare selection remains coherent; report/native document resets on campaign switch. Main skip target remains visible at the library.

findings.title: Customer entry and site describe an obsolete product
findings.evidence: README/docs install and lifecycle; docs/index.html declares1.0.1; privacy denies background service
findings.impact: Users are sent to retired standalone MIND and both-plugin installation; current room is largely absent from onboarding and privacy truth.
findings.repair: Use current Nova Free/Emergent and complete portable package entry, reachable Open/return/help routes, Python3.10 requirement, honest loopback service/history/export boundary. Preserve historical ancestry only as history.
findings.actual_change: Current complete room entry, supported native skill/fallback routes, exact validation/recovery links, current Nova Free/Emergent and actual loopback-service behavior replace obsolete claims. Prior documentation PASS retained historically, not reused for these bytes.

findings.title: Research practice has instructions but no inspectable complete example
findings.impact: Users cannot see how evidence that is topically related fails a particular causal claim or how a negative result can still be useful.
findings.repair: Author a complete, clearly bounded source-to-claim-to-report example and perform a real primary-source comparative inquiry. Demonstrate the decisive mechanism/metric distinction, actual source scope, disconfirming search, honest stopping, audience answer and return event; label synthetic test reviews.
findings.actual_change: Actual official NOAA/NASA comparative inquiry shows measurement reference, aggregation, source vintage, a rejected source and precise missing comparison data. Report answers first, links sources, distinguishes synthesis/procedure from observation, and names the event that warrants re-entry.

findings.title: Persona and authority can replace the caller or reask settled permission
findings.evidence: personas/omnara... Let Nova govern; SKILL paid/authenticated separate edge; fallback wholecampaign
findings.impact: Standalone caller is subordinated to Nova; existing grants risk repeated permission gates; small work acquires the full vault ceremony.
findings.repair: Preserve caller identity and prior task authority. Scale records to useful return/traceability, keep ambitious campaigns possible, and stop only at genuinely new authority or missing consequence-changing inputs.
findings.actual_change: Caller identity and existing authority persist. Small supplied-source work can answer directly; agent owns records when depth/return warrant a vault. Topic-similar sources cannot substitute for the mechanism or measurement needed by the actual question.

findings.title: Package verification does not verify the accepted full product
findings.evidence: scripts/validate_release.py required runtime omits workspace and new references; builder recursive exclusions
findings.impact: A package missing its advertised room can pass. Repository scans recurse old frozen archives and verification data, producing unrelated failures; old PASS receipt ships as current.
findings.repair: Inventory owned current cargo explicitly, require every advertised dependency, verify exact source/package hashes, exclude historical/test state deliberately, preserve old review as historical and provide current bounded evidence. Keep help read-only and native extraction/rebuild checks.
findings.actual_change: Explicit 107-file current source closure includes room, example and all linked guides; exact 108-file package adds manifest. Required dependencies, local links, seed identity and every manifest byte are checked. Actual fresh Windows extraction and payload-tamper check passed.

findings.title: Builder overwrites current artifact and stale receipt claims
findings.evidence: build_workspace_release.py fixed destination, no output option or validation
findings.impact: Failed builds can damage previous candidate and hard-coded skin-only rationale misstates a larger repair. Consumer sets can omit current room or references.
findings.repair: Build deterministic complete one-root candidate under new output directory, stage and verify before publication, reject full namespace collisions, preserve old bytes, current truthful receipt and exact downstream inventory. Carry sidecar/version/art/CI semantics with whole delta.
findings.actual_change: New --output directory is mandatory; existing candidates are preserved. Validate staged closure before publishing. Two source builds and a fresh-extracted-source rebuild are byte identical. Existing CI has Pages and line-ending workflows, no stale no-argument build invocation; parent receives exact consumer selector corrections.

findings.title: Review chronology compares days instead of known instants
findings.impact: Accepts a review predating source access on the same day; rejects a valid cross-zone sequence and accepts unknown -00:00 as UTC.
findings.repair: Compare exact known timestamp instants; preserve explicit date-only granularity; reject unknown offset.

findings.title: Exponent overflow bypasses finite budget validation
findings.impact: Raw JSON 1e400 is parsed as infinity and accepted as a usable budget.
findings.repair: Reject non-finite float results in the common JSON parser, including exponent overflow.

findings.title: Nova integration retains a stale incomplete owner selection
findings.impact: Both consumers retained84files with stale1.1.0 candidate coordinates; the helper excluded examples and linked documentation.
findings.repair: Integrate the full107-file current owner closure, bind both manifests, retain historical overlays before current owner and read future selection/version from the owner.
